content.title: About
content.content: Rum Ball Cookie is a soft, no‑bake treat made from crushed cookies, cocoa, nuts and aromatic rum, bound together with cream cheese. The result is a melt‑in‑your‑mouth ball with a subtle boozy note, perfect for festive occasions.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The rum‑ball tradition started in the United States in the mid‑20th century as a quick, no‑bake dessert.
Dark rum is commonly used for its deep flavor, but any aromatic liqueur can be substituted.
Balls are rolled in cocoa powder, shredded coconut, or chopped nuts, adding texture variety.
Because they are not baked, the recipe preserves maximum aroma and texture contrast.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Sugar and fat provide a quick energy boost, making them a handy snack.

items.title: Antioxidant content
items.content: Cocoa powder is rich in flavonoids, which may support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Minerals from nuts
items.content: Nuts supply magnesium, zinc and heart‑healthy monounsaturated fats.

items.title: Nut and dairy allergies
items.content: The recipe often includes nuts and cream cheese, which can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Alcohol content
items.content: Rum retains a small amount of alcohol; while generally safe in modest amounts, consider children and pregnant individuals.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Sugar and fat make the treat calorie‑dense, so portion control is recommended.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve chilled, dusted with cocoa powder or coconut. Ideal as a post‑meal dessert, tea accompaniment, or party treat.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. For longer storage, freeze up to 1 month, wrapped in plastic film.
